title: What could be finer than to be in San Jose, California, in late January?
excerpt: I’ll be speaking to Christian educators in San Jose, CA at the Association of Presbyterian Church Educators Annual Event ConnectED. This is an excellent gathering – a great way to start the new year. Sign up here.
